title: kate-syntax: fold a capital I in a case flag
summary: A leading flag group rewrites I to i before the case-flag check. (?I)a stays one case flag. A letter I in the pattern body stays I. The test goes in the existing regex tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: regex.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Add fold_flag_case. When the text starts with (? and has a ) , replace I with i inside that flag group only. Leave every later character unchanged. A text with no leading flag group is returned unchanged. Use let-else for the missing prefix and the missing ) . translate_pattern calls fold_flag_case on the translated text before has_leading_case_flag. Do not change has_leading_case_flag. Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not write two if arms that return the same value. Combine them with ||. That is clippy::if_same_then_else. Do not touch translate_pcre or invert_greed. The existing tests minimal_swaps_greedy_quantifiers and a_case_flag_after_m_stays_one_flag stay green. Do not rewrite their assertions. The test a_capital_i_flag_stays_one_flag checks translate_pattern of (?I)a with insensitive true, minimal false, and no captures. The result is (?i)a. translate_pattern of (?mI)a with the same flags is (?mi)a. translate_pattern of I with the same flags is (?i)I. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Stay inside this one behavior. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: regex::tests::a_capital_i_flag_stays_one_flag
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. (?I)a with the insensitive flag becomes (?i)(?I)a. After the change it is (?i)a. A body letter I stays I.
